title: Trigger cases
description: evals/<skill>/trigger-cases.json — does a prompt pull in the skill it should? A flat array of {query, should_trigger}, the shape used across sibling collections, plus two additive keys a plain reader can ignore.

query.description: Exactly what a user would type. Not a paraphrase of the description — a trigger that only fires on its own restatement never fires in practice.

should_trigger.description: Whether THIS skill should be the one loaded. A reader that understands nothing else still gets a correct answer from this field alone.

expect_skill.description: Additive. When should_trigger is false because a DIFFERENT skill should win, name it. A boolean cannot express a collision, and collisions are the failure mode that grows with a collection rather than shrinking.

note.description: Additive. What the case protects. A case whose purpose nobody recorded gets deleted the first time it fails.
